_comment: Import into Pterodactyl 1.x, then replace OWNER/REPO in Docker Images with your actual GHCR image. This runtime uses BOT_MODE and does not evaluate STARTUP.
name: WhatsApp Summary Bot
author: maintainer@example.invalid
description: Personal WhatsApp group summaries through Baileys. Node 24 and dependencies are baked into the image; no Chrome browser is needed. Keep the server volume across deployments. Start in check mode to verify dependencies before pairing.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
# Runtime source and dependencies are provided by the Docker image.
# Preserve every file in the server volume.
exit 0

variables.name: Bot mode
variables.description: Use check first, groups to pair/list WhatsApp groups, models/account to inspect ChatGPT, then run for normal operation. Login/logout are maintenance modes; the OAuth callback remains container-local.

variables.name: WhatsApp authentication directory
variables.description: Persistent Baileys credentials and encryption keys, not a message archive. Keep under /home/container. Old whatsapp-web.js sessions cannot be reused; pair once after migration.

variables.name: AI authentication mode
variables.description: chatgpt uses the separately provisioned OAuth connection. api-key is explicitly selected API billing; put the key in private .env, never Git or the image.

variables.name: Model ID
variables.description: Exact model ID from models mode; blank chooses the account catalog's first available model. Panel environment values override .env.

variables.name: Allowed WhatsApp groups
variables.description: Comma-separated exact group IDs printed by groups mode, including @g.us. Required for run mode.

variables.name: History fetch cap
variables.description: Maximum recent messages to attempt loading per command. No separate message archive is created.

variables.name: On-demand history timeout
variables.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the primary phone to return a requested history range. Keep the bot phone online. This panel value overrides .env.

variables.name: Expected image revision
variables.description: Deployment writes the tested full Git commit SHA. Startup refuses an older or mismatched image. Leave blank only during initial manual setup.

variables.name: ChatGPT loopback login port
variables.description: For node-admin maintenance with an appropriate local callback tunnel. Publishing this allocation does not expose container loopback; do not make the callback public.
